failure: Failure: Noise, arbitrary off-grid data, unknown initial spread, detector blur, unknown detection scale, and experimental validation are not covered by the base theorem. The focused AI proof and prior check are source-reported.
interface: Interface: Pure independent fragmentation without coagulation or growth; time-independent self-similar law; normalized mass conservation; known rates and calibrated complete mass-weighted endpoint. The small-chipping condition is required. The result recovers the mean daughter measure, not the joint sibling law.

claims.title: A renewal conjugacy inverts one finite-time endpoint under small chipping
